title: AdGuard Home
comment: AdGuard Home splits its state into conf/ (AdGuardHome.yaml: upstreams, filters, users, the finished first-run state) and work/ (filter caches, statistics, query log, sessions), and the Daemonless image mounts them as two volumes mirroring the official /opt/adguardhome layout. There is no FreeBSD port, so only a Linux source applies. conf/ is the application and is required; work/ is optional (statistics and the query log reset when absent). Carrying conf/ skips the first-run wizard. DNS/DoT/DoH/DHCP port mappings are install configuration, not state. First multi-volume recipe (the internal development record).
